text.p: Tropical cyclone 08b, with 75 mph winds, is still off the coast of Andhra Pradesh India..about 75-85 miles east-northeast of Nellore. It is moving towards the northwest at 7 mph. It is still a significant risk to shipping but it is also spreading rain into the coast. Rain will become heavy as the cyclone makes landfall in 6-9 hours. Flooding is likely and mudslides possible after the system moves inland. Strong winds and a storm surge will impact the coastal areas, especially north of where it makes landfall. The system should rapidly weaken as it continues inland later in this period.

Tropical Cyclone 08S is a moderate risk to shipping in the southwest India Ocean as top winds are now 75 mph. It should slowly strengthen to about 85-90 mph during the next 24-48 hours. It will mostly affect shipping during this time but it could threaten Mauritius, Reunion or eastern Madagascar in about 72 hours.
